finding: sync_titlebar assigns button.style.name when adapting an existing differently styled action. Pinned2.0.77 declares LuaStyle.name read-only; pinned2.1.23 permits writing. The shared LuaGuiElement.style string setter is available on both and expresses the intended restyle.

LuaGuiElement.style.name: style
LuaGuiElement.style.description: The style of this element. When read, this evaluates to a [LuaStyle](runtime:LuaStyle). For writing, it only accepts a string that specifies the textual identifier (prototype name) of the desired style.

The style of this element. When read, this evaluates to a [LuaStyle](runtime:LuaStyle). For writing, it only accepts a string that specifies the textual identifier (prototype name) of the desired style.

When writing, this clears all custom values set through [LuaStyle](runtime:LuaStyle).
